chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The one who was in charge of the camels of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was Najiya ibn Jundub Al-Khuzai Al-Aslamy, and the one who shaved the head of the Prophet (peace be upon him) during his Hajj was Ma'mar ibn Abdullah ibn Haratha ibn Nasr ibn Awf ibn Aweij ibn Adi ibn Ka'b.

He (peace be upon him) said: And when it was the Hajj of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and he was shaving him, the Quraysh said, 'O Ma'mar! The ear of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is in your hand, and in your hand is the razor.' So Ma'mar said, 'By Allah! I count it as a great favor from Allah upon me.'

He (peace be upon him) said: And Ma'mar was the one who used to prepare the ride for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). So the Messenger of Allah said, 'O Ma'mar! The ride tonight is loose.' So Ma'mar said, 'By my father and my mother! I had tightened it just as I used to tighten it, but some of those who envy me for my place from you, O Messenger of Allah, intended that you would replace me.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'I would not have done it.'

key_terms.بُدْن: Camels used for sacrifice or transport

ai.seo_question: Who shaved the Prophet's head during his Hajj and what did he say about this honor?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the honor bestowed upon Ma'mar ibn Abdullah for shaving the Prophet's head during the Farewell Hajj, illustrating the Shia emphasis on the virtue of those close to the Ahl al-Bayt. It further narrates a subtle incident where the Prophet's saddle loosened due to the envy of others, yet he remained steadfast in not replacing Ma'mar, demonstrating his patience and the enduring nature of divine favor despite worldly jealousy.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

The one who was in charge upon the camels of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was Najiya Bin Jundub Al-Khuzai’e Al-Aslamy, and the one who shaved the head of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> during his<sup>saww</sup> Hajj was Mo’mar Bin Abdullah Bin Harasat Bin Nasr Bin Awf Bin Aweyj Bin Adayy Bin Ka’ab.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And when it was the Hajj of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and he was shaving him<sup>saww</sup>, the Qureysh said, ‘Mo’mar! The ear of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> is in your hands, and in your hand is the razor’. So Mo’mar said, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I count is as a great favour from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon me’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Mo’mar was the one who used to prepare the ride for Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Mo’mar! The ride tonight is loose’. So Mo’mar said, ‘By my father and my mother! I had tightened it just as I used to tighten it, but some of the ones who envy me for my place from you<sup>saww</sup>, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, intending that you<sup>saww</sup> would replace me’. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> would have not done it’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the person in charge of herding the camel for offering by the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, was Najiyah ibn Jundab al-Khuza‘iy al-Aslamiy. The person who shaved the head of the Holy Prophet during his Hajj was Mu‘amar ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Harithah ibn Nasr ibn ‘Awf ibn ‘Awiyj ibn ‘Adiy ibn Ka’b.

He (the Imam) said, ‘During the Hajj of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, as he shaved his head, Quraysh said to him, ‘O Mu’ammar, the ear of the Messenger of Allah is in your hand. Also in your hand is the shaving knife . 5 Mu’ammar then said, ‘I by Allah consider it a great favor on me . 5

He (the Imam) said, ‘Mu’ammar was he who would prepare the saddle on the camel for the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah asked him, ‘O Mu’ammar, how is it that the saddle is prepared loose tonight ? 5 He replied, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, I had prepared it tight as usually I do, but certain ones jealous of my nearness to you wanted to replace me . 5 The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘I would not have allowed it to happen . ‘“
